subject.title: [Bug]: Agent reads workspace files after tool discovery, causing timeouts on natural language queries

question: Should local-model lean fresh turns bias the model toward injected workspace guidance before exposing or encouraging Tool Search, or should Tool Search remain the default discovery path with documented opt-outs?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally default local-model lean runs to Tool Search, while the issue asks for a different first-turn policy that may trade prompt size and discovery behavior for slow-backend reliability.

options.title: Reproduce, Then Bootstrap-First
options.body: Run a current-main slow-backend repro and, if confirmed, change local-model lean fresh turns so workspace guidance is clearly preferred before dynamic discovery without making TOOLS.md a fake availability registry.

options.title: Document Tool Search Default
options.body: Keep the current Tool Search-first lean behavior and document tools.toolSearch:false or explicit tool-surface tuning for backends that cannot handle discovery latency.

options.title: Add A Narrow Opt-In
options.body: Introduce a scoped opt-in only after deciding the default should remain unchanged but some local backends need bootstrap-first behavior.

recommendation.title: Reproduce, Then Bootstrap-First
recommendation.body: Run a current-main slow-backend repro and, if confirmed, change local-model lean fresh turns so workspace guidance is clearly preferred before dynamic discovery without making TOOLS.md a fake availability registry.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent most recently changed the local-model lean Tool Search defaults and tests that govern the affected behavior.
